# Dr. Lilian Kloft-Heller

> Assistant Professor at Maastricht University working at the intersection of
> forensic psychology and psychopharmacology. Her research investigates how
> psychoactive substances — including cannabis, MDMA, benzodiazepines, ayahuasca,
> and psilocybin — affect memory processes, with a focus on false memory
> formation and its implications for eyewitness testimony and criminal
> investigations. Also available as an independent expert witness and forensic
> consultant for legal teams.

Note on naming: she publishes and is cited both as **Lilian Kloft** and as
**Lilian Kloft-Heller**. Both refer to the same person
(ORCID 0000-0002-4615-9581).

- Full name: Lilian Kloft-Heller (also published as Lilian Kloft)
- Affiliation: Maastricht University — Psychopharmacology & Forensic Psychology
- PhD: Maastricht University, defended Cum Laude (awarded to roughly 5% of PhD
  candidates in the Netherlands); triple Cum Laude across bachelor's, master's
  and doctorate
- Postdoc: University of Bonn, funded by an NWO Rubicon grant — benzodiazepine
  effects on memory for virtual reality crime scenarios, using eye-tracking
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4615-9581
- Languages: English, German, Dutch

## Topics

Forensic psychology, psychopharmacology, false memory, eyewitness reliability
and testimony, forensic interviewing, memory under the influence of psychoactive
substances, cannabis, MDMA, benzodiazepines, ayahuasca, psilocybin, legal
psychology, virtual reality crime scenarios, eye-tracking.
